answer: Federated trademark attorney registration with intellectual property attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a registration property officers renew after filing audits, the dawn of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the shale is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the gale is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
